lucy: Heads up — PR #4567 (optimize-toolkit docs) failed linkcheck on CI. /docs/optkit/examples/python.md -> 404 for ../../qprofiles/q4_0.md and go example uses old SDK call generate_text(). Also caching section uses kv_prefetch which is deprecated. Tagging @docs.

oliver: thanks. can you paste the linkcheck snippet?

lucy: ```
LinkCheck: /docs/optkit/examples/python.md
  [404] ../../qprofiles/q4_0.md
  [404] ../../qprofiles/q8_0.md
SnippetError: python/example.py line 12: use of generate_text()
```

aaron: i'll take the python snippet. i'll update to the new SDK call pattern `client.responses.create(...)` and add a short example with streaming.

maria: i'll handle the go example + qprofile renames. what's the canonical mapping?

lucy: mapping: q4_0 -> q4_0_folded, q8_0 -> q8_0_r0. Also note `kv_prefetch` is now `kv_prefetch_policy` (values: `none`, `balanced`, `aggressive`). Add a note in the migration guide.

devon: I can add redirect stubs in the docs site (mkdocs aliases). I'll open a small PR that adds `docs/redirects/qprofiles/*` files.

docs-bot: LinkCheck queued for branch lucy/optkit-fixes — run: https://ci.internal/reports/1234

lucy: thanks — i'll wait for PRs and then rebase #4567.

oliver: i'll review the python PR once it's up. remind me to check example output tokens and the streaming example.

maria: PRs opened: #4570 (go examples + qprofile renames), #4571 (redirects).
